class.name: SfxParameter
class.brief_description: A parameter of the player, declared by [member SfxBank.parameters].
class.description: The game sets it ([method SfxPlayer.set_parameter] or the [code]parameters/<name>[/code] property) and every event of the bank reads it.

members.member: The value before the game sets one.
